issues.explanation: Register defines validation via rules() method instead of the project's #[Validate] attribute pattern used by Login.

conventions.evidence: Follows most: named-route redirects (LogoutController.php:185, Login.php:364, Register.php:427), plain wire:model in livewire/auth/*.blade.php, Blade components x-form-field/x-layouts.app, Password::defaults in AppServiceProvider.php:490, CHANGELOG updated. Deviation: Register.php:396-402 uses rules() with bare public properties instead of #[Validate] attributes per conventions.md.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods with PHPDoc (Login.php:341, Register.php:408, LogoutController.php:178), clear names, consistent Blade/Bulma markup, no dead code or debug output.

requirements.evidence: Login.php:330-364 strict email, auth.failed/auth.throttle on email, 5-try email+IP limit, regenerate + redirectIntended(route home); Register.php:412-427 IP key str()->transliterate('register|'.ip), confirmed/defaults rule, Registered + login + regenerate; routes/web.php:861-883 all contract names/methods/throttles; reset-password.blade.php:665 single name="email"; User.php:469 MustVerifyEmail; ui.php en+pt_BR same keys with Entrar/Senha/Esqueceu a senha?

scope.evidence: Diff only adds auth components/controllers/views/routes/locale/tests plus .env.example/phpunit.xml pins and CHANGELOG entry; no mail theme, nginx, SCSS/JS, or entity changes per out-of-scope.

security.evidence: ensureGuest abort_if(Auth::check(),403) in Login.php:370-373 and Register.php:444-447; EmailVerificationRequest in VerifyEmailController.php:148 blocks tampered id/hash (403); RateLimiter in both submits; {{ }} escaping, no {!! !!}; #[Fillable]/#[Hidden] in User.php:466-467

simplicity.evidence: Lean: RegisterUser.php:61-68 single-purpose Action, ResetPasswordRequest.php:303-307 for 3-field reset, reused x-form-field and x-layouts.app layout; no service layers or duplication.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Auth/LoginTest.php (happy, strict email, auth.failed, 5-try lockout, scoping, remember, unauthorized, key format), RegisterTest.php (happy unverified+VerifyEmail, defaults variants, confirmed, unique, throttle, unauthorized), EmailVerificationTest.php (notice/verify-tamper/throttle/resend), PasswordResetTest.php, HomeTest.php, LocalizationTest.php, ViewConventionsTest.php

review.summary: Adds full session auth with Livewire login/register, logout, guarded home, throttled forgot/reset password, and signed email verification, localized pt_BR/en via ui.php. Comprehensive Pest tests cover happy, validation, lockout, tamper, and unauthorized paths; only nit is Register using rules() instead of the project's #[Validate] pattern, so approve with nits.
